❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the golden ratio?

φ = (1 + √5) / 2 ≈ 1.6180339887. A rectangle is "golden" when its long side divided by its short side equals φ.

How is it used in design?

For pleasing proportions: a 1000px layout splits into ~618px and ~382px columns; type scales (12, 19.4, 31.4…) follow φ steps.

Is the rectangle preview accurate?

Yes — the preview div uses the exact aspect-ratio 1.618… : 1 computed from your base value.
